concept.title: Understanding Physical AI
concept.description: An overview of the rise of Physical AI, focusing on its evolution from traditional robot control to semantic-based AI.
concept.explanation: This flowchart encapsulates the progression of Physical AI from traditional robot control methods to more advanced semantic understanding capabilities, highlighting the transition points and methodologies involved.

example.title: RT2 Application in Robotics
example.description: RT2 showcases using pre-trained language models linked with robotics to predict actions based on visual and contextual data.
example.explanation: This sequence diagram illustrates how RT2 functions in a real-world setup, showing the communication flow between a human, the RT2 model, a robot, and its environment, culminating in a successful task.

learning.title: Practice with Physical AI Systems
learning.description: A structured approach to practicing and enhancing skills in the development and control of Physical AI systems.
